name: Crb2
fix_description: In _transfer, when to == address(this), it should not trigger sellToken and reward distribution. Add validation to reject or handle self-transfers without triggering the sell/distribution logic, or add a cooldown to prevent repeated reward distribution triggers.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is not a simple one-shot bug: it uses a flash loan, repeated swap manipulation, direct token transfers to the vulnerable token contract, and coordinated balance movement through a user address. While the exploit logic is somewhat visible from the test, understanding why these repeated transfers/swaps break the token’s accounting requires protocol-specific analysis and more than a trivial access-control style exploit.
